introduced: Mandatory `plugin_api` compatibility declaration, replacing `min_chiroptera`.
`chiroptera.httpStream()` for streaming HTTP responses.
`ui.dragSource()` and `ui.dropZone()` for declarative panel drag and drop.
The `string_map` plugin setting type.
The `allow_insecure_tls` HTTP request option.
The `dismiss_on_outside_click` panel entry option.
Luau closures directly in UI tree callback props.
The `keyboard_focus` panel entry option.
The `persistent` panel entry option.
`chiroptera.systemStats()`, `chiroptera.cpuCores()`, and `chiroptera.nowMs()`.
The `capture_keys` panel entry option and the `onKey` callback.
The `[widget.actions]` entry table, declaring bar gesture defaults.
`chiroptera.openSettings()`, opening the settings window at the plugin's own settings.
Per-interface network rates, sample timestamps, and disk mount/stat APIs.
Service entries start when the plugin is enabled instead of only at launch, and `onExit(signal, reason)` reports `reload`, `disable`, `uninstall`, or `shutdown`.
`panel.setNeedsFrameTick(bool)`, delivering `onFrameTick(deltaMs)` to an open panel.
Timezone support on `chiroptera.formatTime`, `chiroptera.isValidTimezone(name)`, and `chiroptera.timeFormat()` / `chiroptera.dateFormat()` mirroring `[shell].time_format` / `date_format`.
`chiroptera.sound.load()` and `chiroptera.sound.play()` for plugin audio.
The `ui.markdown` node, `submitOnEnter` on `ui.input`, and `stickToBottom` / `onScroll` / `scrollToBottomRev` on `ui.scroll`.
`require("./path.luau")` loads relative `.luau` modules with entry-local caches and hot reload for loaded modules.
`chiroptera.readFileAsync(path, callback)` for bounded filesystem reads outside plugin VM workers.
Argument-array form of `chiroptera.runAsync()` for direct process execution without shell parsing.
`chiroptera.wallpaperPath(connector)` and `chiroptera.setWallpaperMask(connector, mask)` for source-aligned desktop-widget occlusion masks.
`chiroptera.getSetting(path)` for reading any effective shell config value by TOML dotted path.
`frameVisible` on `ui.input` for hiding the native input background and border.
`panel.openContextMenu(request)` for native context menus in regular and persistent plugin panels.
`onPointerMove` and `onPointerLeave` callbacks on `ui.graph` nodes.
The `layer` panel entry option for choosing the layer-shell layer of a floating plugin panel.
